Online Coding Round :
●

●

●

●

1

1. Power Limit - 20 marks [Solved by brute force]
Given two resources with powers A and B respectively. At each second, you have
to select one resource out of the two to run the software. The power of the
resource at the time of selection should be greater than 1. Every second, the
power of the selected resource gets reduced by 2 and the power of the
unselected resource gets increased by 1. The software stops when at least one
resource has a power of 0.
You are given integers A and B. Print the maximum number of seconds your
software can run if you select the resources optimally as output.
Sample input: 3 5
Sample output: 6
Passed all test cases.
2. Auto Suggest - 50 marks [Solved by DP]
Given a dictionary consisting of N words and a query word S. All the words and
the query word S consist of lowercase alphabets only. You need to auto suggest
the best word from the dictionary that is closest to S. Two words are first
compared by their Levenshtein distance to the word S. If two words have the
same Levenshtein distance, then the lexicographically smaller word is given
priority.
Levenshtein Distance is defined as the minimum number of edits required to
convert one string to another. Operations allowed to edit are insert, delete or
replace a character.
Input: N words S
2

Output: suggested word
Passed all test cases.
3. Backlink Sorting - 50 marks [created 2 dictionaries sorted one and used it]
You are given N webpage titles and corresponding arrays that constrain the
number of backlinks for each webpage. The objective is to rank the web pages in
descending order based on the number of backlinks they have. If two or more
pages have the same number of links then maintain their ordering.
Sample Input:
4
pg1 pg2 pg3 pg4
20 80 40
10
Sample Output:
pg2 pg3 pg1 pg4
Passed all test cases.
40 students shortlisted for interviews held on 9th August 2023 in offline mode in
TPO
Technical Interview - 1 :
●
Tell me about yourself
●
He told me he was from the OS domain and asked if I was comfortable with
that subject, I said yes.
3

●
Asked me to draw the architecture between end user and os (the kernel
diagram one) and explain it.
●
Difference between Linux and Ubuntu, then compare it with windows.
●
List all the linux commands you know (asked the implementation of some)
●
Told me to list all the memory units I knew in ascending order.
●
Asked me which memory can be accessed fastest by CPU and then gave me
various options and asked to order them ( RAM, CD, Hard disk, cache
something like that)
●
Asked me how a small RAM can run a large program, I answered using virtual
memory, then he asked to explain what virtual memory is.
●
Asked me about paging and segmentation and to state different types of

replacement.
●
Asked me to write any code in any language just it should have a practical

I wrote a python code for student and course management)
●
List all the git commands you know, then he asked some follow up questions
like can you create branch of branch etc.
●
Asked me if I had any questions.

5

Lasted 45 min. 26 shortlisted for HR
HR Interview :
●
Introduce yourself.
●
Internship discussion, how was Bangalore, team, what did you learn,
highlight on some learning you gained excluding technical and overall
experience.
●
Why DB, if you get PPO from SAP Labs would you accept (I said no), why not?
●
Where do you see yourself in 5 years?
●
Are you comfortable with relocation
Lasted 25 - 30 min
All 26 candidates were selected.
Tips:
●
For DSA practice leetcode questions and follow any code sheet. I also
referred to Geeks for Geeks.
●
Practice all the core CS subjects from most asked interview questions. (like
from interviewbit)
●
If there is any ambiguity in understanding question, ask them and clarify,
●
Know all your projects mentioned in the resume and their tech stack
thoroughly. Do not lie on your resume (maybe exaggerate)
●
Always ask some questions when they ask if you have some and show
interest.
●
While solving some logical questions, explain your approach and do not stay
silent for long.
6

●
Go through the geeks for geeks puzzles section :
https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/puzzles/?ref=shm
●
If you don't know something state it and then maybe try to attempt it
●
Prepare a proper introduction excluding just your educational details.
All the best!
7
